verdicts.reason: Both break the hierarchy in the same ways. 'THE NIGHT SET' has dropped from eyebrow above the price to below the body copy. 'Worth $72…' is set larger than the product description, so the fine print competes with the message. The cream jar is cut off from the serum and stranded under the CTA as a tiny orphan. A also leaves an awkward empty gap between the circle and $48. B pushes the logo into a tiny top-right corner, which weakens the brand, and its bottle spills out of the circle, making a cramped top. A wins narrowly because its logo stays centred and readable.
